conditions.displayName: ERROR-severity log entries sustained above ~6 per 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="logging.googleapis.com/log_entry_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="basecamper" AND metric.labels.severity="ERROR"

documentation.content: Spike in ERROR-severity logs (every `reportError()` call lands here, including failures that still returned a 2xx to the user — webhook handlers, background jobs, degraded fallbacks). Open Error Reporting for grouped stacks; correlate with `requestId`. Check `JobRun` and `EmailLog.status=FAILED` if the spike aligns with the nightly jobs.
